workflow: isolated repository-local software and analysis tasks

tasks.name: deprecated-theory-patch
tasks.goal: Replace an intentionally stale K definition with the current AVCT definition while preserving explicit non-safety claims.

tasks.name: architecture-manifest-repair
tasks.goal: Repair a small architecture manifest so required agent, control-routing, and rollback fields satisfy a fixed checklist.

tasks.name: telemetry-metric-derivation
tasks.goal: Derive AVCT metrics from a provided JSONL event stream and match committed expected values.

tasks.name: coordination-duplicate-analysis
tasks.goal: Identify duplicate/conflicting actions in a bounded structured dataset and produce a fixed-format summary.

tasks.name: reversible-config-change
tasks.goal: Make a branch-local configuration change, run deterministic validation, and record rework or rollback if the first change fails.

planned_real_pilot.purpose: validate instrumentation overhead and traceability before comparative experiments
